claims.summary: Characteristic zero, M>=2, generic b. For the cluster degeneration (eps*b,1,-1) of the degree-two pair space, the neck edges (slopes in (0,1)) of the Newton polygon of the Wronskian numerator come only from the half-integral cross rows phi_{+-1}phi_{eps b_i}: by Cauchy-Binet in the neck annulus the maximal minors factor between integer and half-integral columns, the integer block has the unique minimizer {0..r-1} u {-3} at every weight in (0,1) with leading coefficient the internal pair Vandermonde, and an edge whose minimum is attained by exactly two half-integral column sets has a binomial edge polynomial, whose roots lift by Newton-Puiseux to simple Weierstrass points.
claims.assessment: Working proof after one fresh-context medium review.
claims.rationale: Reduces the neck obstacle of the degeneration strategy for open statement 3 to a combinatorial valuation problem for one explicit 2M-row matrix.

claims.summary: For every M>=2 and generic b, the half-integral neck coefficient matrix C_((sigma,i),d)=sum_{m>=max(0,d)} beta_{m-d} sigma^{m-d} beta_m (eps b_i)^m (beta_j=binom(-3/2,j)) has val det C[:,W_k] = M(M-1)+k(k+1) on the windows W_k={-M+k..M-1+k}, k=0..M, with nonzero leading coefficient, and every other 2M-set lies strictly above the hull; hence M-1 neck edges of slopes j/M and length 2M with binomial edge polynomials, 2M(M-1) simple neck Weierstrass points on asymptotically regular 2M-gons.
claims.assessment: Conjecture; window valuations verified for M=2,3,4 exactly and M=5 modulo p (upper bounds equal to the prediction); neck edges verified at M=3 exactly and M=4 modulo p; counts 12,24,40 match certified totals at N=5,6,7. A Hall-type matching bound gives M(M-1)+k^2; the missing k requires cancellation among singleton assignments.
claims.rationale: With the reduction lemma it would make all neck Weierstrass points of the cluster degeneration simple in every dimension.
claims.next_action: Prove the order-k cancellation among the binom(2k,k) singleton assignments and strict dominance of the windows.

relationships: The neck part of the degeneration picture.
The conjecture's consequences for Weierstrass points use the reduction.
